data.title: 一色彩羽 · 看台上尚热的红茶
data.description: 活动收尾后的足球场看台，彩羽穿珊瑚色防风外套和灰色运动长裤，坐着把一罐红茶推向身旁空位。另一罐握在自己手里；她抬起下巴装作随意，笑意却藏不住。夕阳与看台反光一起照亮脸部。
data.action: 把热红茶推向身旁空位，抬下巴掩饰笑意。
data.promptProse: Iroha Isshiki nudges a warm tea can toward the empty bench place beside her, keeping the second can between her hands. Her coral windbreaker over an ivory sweatshirt and charcoal athletic trousers suit the finished sports event. She raises her chin nonchalantly, a small grin betraying the gesture. The seated medium view places the empty goal distant behind. Sunset lights the cans and hair edges; reflected field light softly reveals her honey-brown eyes.
